title: Story premise ENT075: The Tiny Birthday Candle
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (silent emotional stories). Hook: One little light is already here. Takeaway/theme: The scale of a gathering is not the scale of its care.
description: A figure plans a grand birthday display but only one small candle arrives. They arrange empty chairs in disappointment, then friends enter carrying single tiny lights of their own, forming a constellation around the modest cake without changing its size.
